workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison. I've read both Elena and David's calendars. Unfortunately, NONE of the proposed slots work for both Elena and David. Every single slot you listed has at least one of them busy (or is outside business hours for the 17:00-end slots).

Here are the slots where BOTH Elena and David are free (30-min slots):
- Mon: 11:00-11:30
- Tue: 09:00-09:30, 09:30-10:00
- Wed: 13:00-13:30, 13:30-14:00
- Thu: 09:30-10:00, 14:30-15:00, 15:00-15:30
- Fri: 15:00-15:30, 15:30-16:00

Could you check if either Priya or Marcus is free during any of these times? It appears none of your original slots overlap with Elena and David's availability. We may need to find a completely different time, or this could be a case where no common slot exists.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:

Could you double-check your availability analysis for Elena and David? If confirmed, there appears to be no 30-minute slot where all four partners are free next week. We would then need to report infeasible.

workspace.text:

- Tue: 09:00-10:00
